title: Everyone Is Home / Sab Ghar Aaye
note: Original lyrics written for Cheeko. Not based on any existing song. Hindi needs a native speaker check.

styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

the lamb is with the sheep,
the moon is in the sky,

sections.name: Outro
lines: {instruments carry the melody, very soft humming, slowing down and fading out}
